entries.title: YMCA360 App Rewards — How Members Redeem (SOP)
entries.content:
Who can use rewards: CURRENT FACILITY MEMBERS only. Each reward can be redeemed once per calendar year per member. Rewards can only be used on a NEW registration — members can't ask for a refund of something they already paid for in order to use an app reward.

How a member redeems a reward (in the YMCA360 app):
1. Open the YMCA360 app and tap My Points.
2. Go to the Rewards tab and choose the reward.
3. The app asks them to confirm the reward can only be redeemed once per calendar year — they type YES. The screen shows the email address the confirmation will go to.
4. They get an email (usually within a few minutes) confirming the request was submitted.

What happens next (Business Office — the front desk doesn't process rewards):
- The Business Office reviews reward requests weekly in Daxko.
- Approved rewards are marked "Ready" in the YMCA360 portal, and the member gets a second email.
- The Business Office checks eligibility (not used in the past calendar year), registers the member in Daxko for the reward, then either applies the membership dues adjustment (for the next month) or sends a coupon code, depending on the reward.
- The reward is marked "Picked Up" in the YMCA360 portal with a note that the coupon code was sent or the dues adjustment was applied. Support@tucsonymca.org is notified once the member is registered.

If a member asks where their reward is: requests are processed weekly, so allow about a week after the "submitted" email. They'll get a "Ready" email when it's approved.

Questions: Businessoffice@tucsonymca.org and Support@tucsonymca.org.

Source: SOP "YMCA360 App Reward Redemption Process", updated 5.19.26.
